text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
—I am most deeply rejoiced and honored~! 
—Most deeply rejoiced and honored indeed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Today is the auspicious day of Lady 
Inari's birth! We humbly present you with 
the spirit of harmony~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What's the big idea, you two!? 
What's this about the spirit of 'Wa'...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What I humbly present to you on this 
occasion is a bamboo "canteen" fashioned 
by my own hands. Please, do make use of it 
during your training...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
From me, I present "wagashi" to brighten 
your afternoon snack! These select mame 
daifuku are as white as fresh snow, and 
the transparency of the agar is like a 
babbling brook!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A thermos, traditional Japanese 
sweets—oooh, what fine 'wa' style! Hit me 
right in the soul, thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nay, nay! This isn't the end of it! In the 
kitchen, piled high upon a platter vast as 
the full moon— is a towering mountain of 
inari sushi!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Inarizushi too!? A whole mountain 
piled high... well now, that's 
something...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—At the foot of the mountain where old 
memories dwell, Tracers gathers where the 
young maidens excel. In full bloom, the 
flowers of Edo! Revering that name—

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Anamori Inari's trade name, it is~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...And so! Thank you as always for all 
your energy! Please accept our feelings!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A-A gift, sushi... and even an 
introductory speech... Well, well, 
well...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks a bunch! ...That's weird, my 
eyes are gettin' all teary today!
